Packing List 
1. 1*Switch (See the product label for more details) 
2. 1*Wall Hanger (Shared mounting holes with DIN Rail Kit) 
3. 1*Console Cable (USB to RJ45 Connector) 
4. 1*User Manual (Printed Copy) 
● Any network utilizing a mixture of copper and fiber 
● IP connectivity and communication 
● CCTV system such as network camera, access control  
Application 
1. Eco-friendly metal case, plug-and-play 
2. AC/DC redundant power input 
3. Rich Led indicators for real-time monitoring 
4. Resilient to ESD, EMI, and power surges  
5. Compliant with industrial testing standard 
6. Layer 2/Layer 3 covering static and dynamic routing, 
ARP,  ECMP, IPV4/IPV6, VRRP, RIP, OSPF, BGP4, 
IS-IS, VLAN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, QoS, Ring, SNMP 
v1/v2c/v3, MAC address, IPV4/IPV6, Web/Telnet/CLI/
SSH, Standard MIB... 
7. Wide port combination(2/4/5/6/8/9/10/12/16/20/28/52) 
8. Rich speed choices 100M/1000M/2.5G/10G for core 
layer, distribution layer, and access layer applications 
 
Login Interface 
Key Features 
P: Power, Green Color 
On: power status is normal 
Off: power off or power connection failure 
S: System indicator, Green Color 
On: Normal operation 
Off: Connection failure 
Blinking: Device initialization 
Copper Status, Green Color 
On: port link up 
Blinking: data is in normal transmission 
Off: port link down 
 
Copper Speed, Yellow Color 
On: port speed is 1000M 
Off: port speed is 10/100M 
 
Fiber port, Green Color 
On: port link up 
Off: port link down 
Blinking: data is in normal transmission 
 
Reset Button 
Restore factory settings, long press≥8 seconds 
IP address login 
 
1. Open browser and enter 192.168.x.xxx in the 
address bar. (Google browser is recommended) 
2. Default IP Address: 192.168.56.166 
Mechanical Drawing (Reference Only) 
Console port login 
 
Common serial port software includes SecureCRT and 
putty. Take SecureCRT for an example. 
 
1. Open the SecureCRT, select “New session”. 
2. Select “Serial”, click “Next”. 
3. Select relative COM port, baud rate 115200, flow 
control and delete the "√" on the RTS/CTS selection 
bar, click “Next”, then click “Ok” 
4. Click “Enter”, put in user name/password “admin”. 
This is only a simple introduction to the login method, 
please refer to the Web manual/CLI manual.

● Remove the grounding screw from the switch. 
 
● Use the grounding screw to attach the ring terminal of 
the grounding cable to the grounding screw hole.  
 
● Fasten the screw 
 
● Connect the other end of the grounding cable to the 
grounding system. 
1. Grounding screw hole

3. Grounding screw                                 
4. Grounding cable       
5. Grounding sign 
Usage Guide 
Please prepare 
 
● Category 5e or better cable for RJ45 ports 
● Fiber cables (patchcords) and modules for fiber 
ports 
● Installation tools (screwdrivers, ESD wrist strap, 
pliers etc.) 
● Wear an ESD wrist strap 
Make sure the wrist strap makes good skin contact 
and is reliably grounded 
 
● Mount the switch  
Make sure the spring of the DIN rail mounting bracket 
compresses against the upper edge of the DIN rail 
 
● Secure the position 
Rotate the switch down toward the DIN rail until the 
DIN rail mounting bracket clicks 
Step 1：Installing the din switch 
Step 2：Connecting the grounding cable 
The power input end of the switch has a noise filter, 
whose central ground is directly connected to the 
chassis to form the chassis ground. 
 
You must securely connect this chassis ground to the 
earth so the faradism and leakage electricity can be 
released to the earth to minimize EMI susceptibility of 
the switch.  
 
Correctly connecting the grounding cable for the switch is 
vital to lightning protection and EMI protection. 
Step 3：Connecting power cords 
● Make sure each power cord has a separate circuit 
breaker. 
● Before connecting a power cord, make sure the 
circuit breaker for the power cord is turned off. 
● Din-rail industrial Ethernet switches support redundant 
dual DC power supply. You can connect one or two 
DC power supply according to your requirement. 
To avoid connection mistakes, identify the positive 
(+) and negative (-) marks above the DC power 
receptacle for the terminal block connection. 
Installation procedure as follows  
1. Make sure the switch power off 
2. Correctly connecting the grounding cable for the 
switch 
3. Connect the DC power to the positive(+) and negative
(-) of the terminal block (red cord connect “+”, black 
cord connect “-”), fasten the screws through the screw
-driver 
4. Turn on and check the power indicator on the front 
panel of the device. If the power indicator is on, the 
power supply is working normally. 
Step 4：Verifying the installation 
After you complete the installation, verify the following 
information: 
1. There is enough space around the switch for the 
heat dissipation. 
2. The DIN rail/mounting ears are securely installed. 
3. The grounding cable is connected correctly. 
4. If the power supply is applied as required by the 
switch properly . 
5. The power cords are correctly connected. 
6. If an interface cable for a port is routed outdoors, 
verify that a network port lightning protector is 
used for the port. 
7. If a power line is routed from outdoors, verify that a 
surge protected power strip is used for the switch.
